prompt: Create a vertical magazine moodboard collage for Patou, a handbag and accessories brand. Make it feel unmistakably like this brand, not a generic fashion collage. Use these concrete cues as visual evidence: aesthetic keywords: joyful, sustainable, feminine, fresh, detail-oriented; key silhouettes and pieces: mini bags, shoulder bags, top-handle bags, soft totes; materials and surface texture: leather, satin, raffia, chain hardware; palette: cream, blush, black, red, seasonal prints. Show a varied product mix selected from these piece types: mini bags; shoulder bags; top-handle bags; soft totes. Use one hero tile per product type, with every main product visibly different in shape and category. Do not repeat the same item, do not show the same product in another colour, and do not use mirrored, rotated, cropped, or alternate-angle duplicates as separate tiles. If a detail close-up is included, it must support a different hero product and must not become another copy of the same garment/accessory. Build the board from 6-9 distinct fragments: bag silhouettes, handles, closures, hardware, interior glimpses, leather or textile grain, scale on body, optional context only when it matches the brand, a few close crops of characteristic details, and brand-specific cut-paper devices such as angular crops, torn edges, irregular frames, textile echoes, or simple hand-drawn accents. Use model casting that matches the brand range: female-only brands should show only female models; male-only brands should show only male models; brands that read as unisex or both menswear and womenswear should show both male and female models, not only one gender. The background can use the general mood colour of the brand. Context is optional. Use an interior, plant, prop, street detail, landscape, or other space only when it clearly supports the brand atmosphere. Reviewer correction brief: Off vibe. Use fewer chains and straw pieces, more totes and small geometric bags, and include the brand name only where it is an authentic product mark. Must include: small geometric top-handle bag; clean modern tote; compact bucket or trapeze form; one authentic Patou product mark; fresh black, white, red and bright accent colour. Must avoid: straw-led resort styling; heavy chain bags; bohemian beach props; repeated round bags. Composition: Crisp geometric blocks and lively colour accents with every silhouette different. Context: Graphic Paris studio and city fragments with youthful couture polish. Casting: Use no more than two images of the same person. Match the brand's womenswear, menswear, or unisex range. Duplicate policy: Every hero product, detail crop, person, pose, colourway, and setting must be visibly distinct. Text policy: No accidental words, labels, captions, watermarks, or unrelated logos. Brand-mark policy: One authentic product wordmark is allowed; no extra generated lettering. Before finalizing the collage, check that no product appears twice. Keep the composition editorial and cohesive, with varied crop sizes and negative space. Avoid generic minimalist luxury, anonymous beige moodboards, random street-style filler, items that contradict the brand cues, repeated views of the same product, repeated colourways of one product, mirrored/rotated duplicates, sterile product-grid layouts, and literal palette swatch strips. Approachable magazine collage style, high-resolution but not over-polished; it can feel slightly artsy, playful, or lightly cartoonish while keeping products readable. Natural professional lighting, crisp product detail, tactile textures, rich but believable colour. No accidental text, captions, labels, watermarks, or unrelated logos. Vertical portrait format. If people are shown, they must be adult fashion models. Absolutely no typography anywhere in the image: do not write the brand name, initials, slogans, captions, labels or decorative letters. This is a bags-only board. Do not include dedicated shoe, jewellery or clothing product tiles.
refinement_notes: Regenerated with stronger brand-specific silhouettes, product-only composition, and removal of generic filler identified in the PDF audit.
